title: TextButton
summary: Clickable text GUI element. Activated is the modern cross-device click event (fires for mouse, touch, and gamepad); MouseButton1Click is the mouse-only legacy.

events.name: Activated
events.description: Fires on completed activation across ALL input types (mouse click, touch tap, gamepad). The recommended event.

events.name: MouseButton1Click
events.description: Legacy: mouse left-click only. Prefer Activated.

properties.name: (inherits TextLabel text props)
properties.description: Text, TextScaled, Font, colors — same as TextLabel.

explanation.whatItIs: A button: the fundamental 'player decides something' control in GUIs.
explanation.whyItExists: Menus, shops, and inventories run on buttons.
whenToUse: Menu navigation, shop purchases, ability buttons
tips: Always use Activated for cross-platform; MouseButton1Click ignores mobile/gamepad
Debounce rapid taps on expensive actions
Disable (Active=false) during cooldowns and style accordingly
commonMistakes: Using MouseButton1Click and mobile players 'can't click'
Buttons too small for touch (aim ≥ 44px equivalent)
Client-only consequences — purchases/state must go through the server via remotes

examples.title: Shop button → server purchase
examples.code:
-- LocalScript in a TextButton
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local buyEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyItem")
local button = script.Parent

local lastClick = 0
button.Activated:Connect(function()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastClick < 0.5 then return end   -- debounce
    lastClick = now
    buyEvent:FireServer("Sword")
end)
